cheat codes for your 20s (that
will help you get dangerously
ahead)

one skill a year

pick one skill every year, like cooking, coding or public speaking, and go deep on it. ten years of this makes you the person with ten skills everyone else wishes they had.

saving the first 10%

move 10% of every payment into savings the day it arrives, before you can spend it. starting small in your 20s quietly beats starting big in your 40s.

asking older people

ask someone 20 years older what they wish they'd done at your age. one honest answer can save you years of learning the same painful lesson the hard way, alone.

five minute lessons

spend 5 minutes a day learning something outside your field: history, art, science, psychology. people who know a little about everything get noticed in every room they walk into.

a body you'll need later

train your body 3 times a week now, even badly. the energy, sleep and confidence you build in your 20s are the foundation you'll be standing on for the rest of your life.
